steps.text: Growing up means making smart choices. Some substances — tobacco, alcohol, and drugs — harm the body and are never worth it. Let's practise saying no.
Read each situation and choose the healthy response, then move to the next one.
Friends may pressure you to try harmful things. A firm, polite “No thanks” is a strong, smart choice — real friends respect it.
If you ever feel pressured or unsafe, tell a trusted adult — a parent, teacher, or elder. Saying no protects your health and your future.

coach.mission: Practise saying no to harmful substances.
whenStuck: Read the situation and pick the healthy response, then tap “Next Scenario”.
The safe choice is always to refuse harmful substances.
whenWrong: Tobacco, alcohol, and drugs harm the body — the healthy answer is to say no.

whenCorrect: Right — saying no is the smart, healthy choice.
Good — real friends respect a firm “No thanks”.
